answer_1.quote: We rescore sequence-to-sequence hypotheses as in Section 3.1. Each hypothesis is assigned its log probability (uni-SANLM, GPT-2) or pseudo-log-likelihood score (bi-SANLM, BERT, M-BERT, RoBERTa, XLM).
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in machine translation and automatic speech recognition by rescoring n-best hypotheses using pseudo-log-likelihood scores from masked language models.

answer_2.quote: We tune the LM weight λ on the development set to minimize word error rate (WER) for ASR or maximize tokenized BLEU for NMT. We then evaluate on the test set.
